positive: fixed random floor(n_pos/2), epoch-independent, identical R0/R1
negative_regions: hard-negative AND canonical weak-Box union; hard-negative AND complement
negative_budget: floor(n_region/2) each image each region; zero/one selects zero; no redistribution
R0: epoch-keyed random priorities independently per negative region
R1: descending current post-forward sigmoid probability, detached; epoch-keyed deterministic random ties per region
geometry: same frozen 4F1 six discrete operations; inverse logits to canonical, select, forward-transform mask
loss: unchanged per-image 0.5 selected-positive mean +0.5 selected-negative mean; empty class zero
initialization: fresh common seeded original model and local TinyViT; historical final forbidden
probe: independent fresh model trajectory: first batch update, save, uninterrupted next batch vs disk-restored next batch; discarded before full epoch
evaluation: none in5C0; new_dev independent evaluator reserved for5C1
cross_epoch_diagnostic: epoch0/1 mask changes under same detached student-output snapshot; not a second training epoch
diagnostic_distributions: count,mean,min,q10,q50,q90,max of mu,var,c_sam,student probability and BCE; inside/outside selected/unselected; no GT
stopping: nonfinite outputs/loss/gradient/parameters; budget mismatch; access breach; non-exact resume; unexplained empty supervision; no performance selection
